vibe: Sophisticated, warm, inviting, educational, high-end wellness spa. NOT clinical, explicit, or cheap.

spacing.philosophy: Generous Spacing Philosophy (p-6, p-8, p-12, p-24) to emulate a premium wellness spa.
spacing.bento_grid: Wide gaps (gap-8 to gap-12) for courses, tight gaps (gap-4) for dashboard widgets.

cards.style: bg-white border border-[#E8E0E5] rounded-2xl shadow-sm hover:-translate-y-1 hover:shadow-md transition-all duration-300

buttons.primary: bg-[#9A3555] text-white rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#7A2A44] transition-colors shadow-sm
buttons.secondary: bg-[#F4E1E6] text-[#2A1B2E] rounded-full px-8 py-3 hover:bg-[#EED0D9] transition-colors

header.style: sticky top-0 z-50 bg-white/70 backdrop-blur-2xl border-b border-[#E8E0E5]/50

hero_background.description: Abstract elegant 3D composition, soft flowing silk fabrics in blush pink and deep plum, for hero banner or age verification gateway background.

ai_advisor_sage.description: Abstract glowing orb representing Sage the AI Advisor, use in chat widget.

course_level_1.description: Level 1: Self-intimacy image. Minimalist still life stones.

course_level_3.description: Level 3: Diverse Intimacy. Amethysts and spa objects.

course_level_4.description: Level 4: Advanced Intimacy. Shallow water reflection.

instructions_to_main_agent.fonts: Import Playfair Display and Outfit from Google Fonts.
instructions_to_main_agent.age_verification: Create a sophisticated, serene full-screen overlay (using the hero_background image with a blur). Don't make it look like a harsh warning; frame it as 'A space for adult exploration. Please confirm you are 18+'.
instructions_to_main_agent.landing_page: Use large elegant Playfair Display for the 'WELCOME TO THE ACADEMY' hero. Overlay max bg-white/30 on the hero image so text remains clear.
instructions_to_main_agent.courses_grid: Use a Bento Grid layout for the 4 levels. E.g., Self-Intimacy gets a large span, others smaller. Include the provided course images.
instructions_to_main_agent.dashboard: Use a soft, card-based layout with rounded-2xl and soft shadows. Include a progress circle or soft progress bars.
instructions_to_main_agent.ai_advisor: Place the 'Sage' floating orb widget fixed at the bottom right. Use backdrop-blur and glassmorphism for the chat panel.
instructions_to_main_agent.icons: Use lucide-react with thin, elegant stroke widths (strokeWidth={1.5}).
